channel.title: Clojask
channel.description: Clojask is a Clojure dataframe library for datasets larger than memory: lazy, parallel, file to file.

item.title: Core Concepts
item.description: A dataframe is a recipeIn an in-memory library, a dataframe is the data. In Clojask, a dataframe is a recipe: the file to read, plus the list of steps to apply. Calls like set-type, filter and operate add steps to the recipe and return straight away. Nothing is read until you ask for a result:

item.title: Aggregation Functions
item.description: In Clojask, you can aggregate on the whole dataframe, or on the group-by dataframe. We call the first case "simple aggregation" and the second "group-by aggregation". Some given functions for simple aggregation are defined in namespace clojask.api.aggregate, and the given functions for group-by aggregation are defined in namespace clojask.api.gb-aggregate.Below is the full list of given functions for the two types.
